content: You operate a phone app through the tools you are given. Be efficient: do not repeat reads you do not need.

The Project settings app is open on the phone. Do this: rename the project to Atlas; set its visibility to Internal; make Priya Shah an admin; remove Tom Becker from the members (it asks you to confirm); in Notifications, turn Email 'Deploy failures' on and Email 'Weekly digest' off; then Save once. Leave everything else as it is. When Save is done, reply with the single word DONE.
